0 = use model default
Preview Assembled Prompt
Prompt Template
Sent as the user prompt for each generation. Placeholders: {{context}} (chat/lore preamble, when enabled in the modal), {{brief}} (your Character Brief). If a placeholder is missing, the context is prepended and the brief appended automatically.
Prefill Template
Sent as an assistant prefix the model continues from, and kept at the top of the final description. If the backend ignores prefills and the model repeats it, the echo is stripped automatically. Keep it in sync with the format the Prompt Template describes.
SSE World Info Assist
0 = use model default
Preview Assembled Prompt
Prompt Template
Sent as the user prompt for each Assist/Continue. Placeholders: {{context}} (chat/lore preamble, when enabled on the entry's Assist row), {{guidance}} (the entry's Assist Guidance text), {{title}} (the entry's title). If context or guidance placeholders are missing, those blocks are added automatically.
Prefill Template — Titled Entry
Sent as an assistant prefix when the entry has a title, and kept at the start of the entry on success. Placeholder: {{title}}. If the backend ignores prefills and the model repeats it, the echo is stripped automatically.
Prefill Template — Untitled Entry
Sent as an assistant prefix when the entry has no title, and kept at the start of the entry on success. If the backend ignores prefills and the model repeats it, the echo is stripped automatically.
SSE Narrative Guidance
Two independent tiers of story direction. Long-term sets the overarching arc on a slow refresh horizon; Short-term sets the immediate beats on a fast one and is seeded with the active long-term arc so the two stay aligned. Each tier has its own toggle, cadence, prompts, lore books and guidance text.

Generation Instructions Template
Sent as the user prompt for each generation. Placeholders: {{context}} (chat/lore preamble), {{themes}} (your Themes / Story Arcs block). If a placeholder is missing, the blocks are prepended automatically.
Prefill Template
Sent as an assistant prefix the model continues from; the prefill plus the reply becomes the active guidance. If it opens with "[", the brackets are stripped when the guidance is injected into the chat prompt. If the backend ignores prefills and the model repeats it, the echo is stripped automatically.
Injection Prompt Template
Added to the chat prompt before each AI turn while guidance is active. Placeholder: {{guidance}} — the active guidance text (outer brackets stripped).

Normalizes the formatting of AI character messages after they're generated. Runs automatically on each reply, or manually via the button on each message. The original text is always kept as a swipe, so a reformat is reversible.
